command:
set -euo pipefail
REPO=$HOME/.claude/star/local_bridge_state/repo
BR=chatgpt-gpt56sol-avatar-parallax-benefit-ab-20260912
PATH0=research_entity/avatar/evidence/PARALLAX_BENEFIT_AB_20260912/blind_contact_sheet.jpg
LIVE=/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual/buehne.html
PRE=$(sha256sum "$LIVE"|awk '{print $1}')
git -C "$REPO" fetch -q origin "refs/heads/$BR:refs/remotes/origin/$BR"
HEAD=$(git -C "$REPO" rev-parse "refs/remotes/origin/$BR")
TD=$(mktemp -d /tmp/avatar-contact-preview-XXXXXX); trap 'rm -rf "$TD"' EXIT
git -C "$REPO" show "$HEAD:$PATH0" > "$TD/in.jpg"
python3 - "$TD/in.jpg" <<'PY'
from PIL import Image
import io,base64,sys,hashlib
p=sys.argv[1]; im=Image.open(p).convert('RGB'); print('SOURCE_SIZE=%dx%d'%im.size); print('SOURCE_SHA256='+hashlib.sha256(open(p,'rb').read()).hexdigest())
w=420; h=round(im.height*w/im.width); im=im.resize((w,h),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
b=io.BytesIO(); im.save(b,'JPEG',quality=48,optimize=True); raw=b.getvalue()
print('PREVIEW_SIZE=%dx%d'%im.size); print('PREVIEW_BYTES=%d'%len(raw)); print('PREVIEW_B64='+base64.b64encode(raw).decode())
PY
POST=$(sha256sum "$LIVE"|awk '{print $1}')
echo LIVE_PRE_SHA=$PRE
echo LIVE_POST_SHA=$POST
test "$PRE" = "$POST"
echo PREVIEW_READONLY=PASS
